notes.title: Casino update full release.
notes.content: The casino has been added to the main game branch. Fixed several bugs with the casino and also with the main game. The casino should be close to final state, but the desert town will possibly have other events added like a race thru the town. Next, I will be working on the physics and handling of the buggy and track design. This will be a major update and will take some time because it will affect much of the game, such as AI design. Follow on Discord for more frequent updates.
